title: Hollow 2
description:
SHAKHTER-ONEHorrors wake up once again on board Shakhter-One. The history of Mark's mental tragedy and family life comes clearer with every minute spent on this hollowed spaceship. The curse of a never-ending loop can only be stopped by one thing – the truth. But all the secrets are kept jealously by these dark corridors blended with Mark's memories.

BREAK THE CYCLEIn Hollow 2, exploring and surviving won't be enough to learn your past and unravel all secrets. With re-designed, fast, and friendly mechanics, your mission is to purge an abandoned station in order to reach your goal. Use all weapons and tools you find to make sure that not even a single creature can stand between you and the truth. Run, fight, hide, explore – do your best to destroy the Shakhter-One once and forever!
description_short: Once again, you are on board Shakhter-One. Traverse the deck of a well-known mining ship and the depths of Mark's twisted mind blended together. Run, fight, hide, explore – discover, what really happened to this place and do your best to destroy Shakhter-One.
